licence.scope: ISRO (DOS) website copyright policy, level 2 (owner's website terms): it covers material on isro.gov.in and does not name the INSAT-3D sounder response functions, and third-party material is excluded. No statement was found on the pages that serve the curves: the NWP SAF RTTOV spectral-response-function page (https://nwp-saf.eumetsat.int/site/software/rttov/download/coefficients/spectral-response-functions/) lists the INSAT-3D sounder files with no terms, and the WMO OSCAR instrument page (https://space.oscar.wmo.int/instruments/view/sounder_insat) shows only a WMO copyright line; the SVO-cited ISRO page https://www.isro.gov.in/spacecraft/communication-satellites returned 404. The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.
